name: ELEX WP Image Optimize and CleanUp
author: ELEXtensions

sections.description:
Improve your website’s speed and SEO effortlessly with WordPress Image Optimize and CleanUp. This lightweight yet powerful plugin helps you compress, optimize, and clean up unused images, ensuring your site remains fast and clutter-free.

Key Features:
✔ Automatic & Bulk Image Compression – Reduce image file size without losing quality.
✔ Remove Unused Images – Identify and clean up orphaned media files.
✔ SEO-Friendly Optimization – Retains alt text and metadata for search rankings.
✔ WooCommerce Compatible – Works seamlessly with product images.

Why Use This Plugin?
A slow website hurts user experience and SEO. With this plugin, you can enhance page speed, free up storage, and optimize images automatically—without losing quality!

If you have any custom requirement on WordPress image optimization & cleanup, please feel to contact ELEX Development Services explaining your business case.
If you have any queries please contact ELEX support

External Services

This plugin connects to the TinyPNG API to optimize images.

  • What the service is and what it is used for: The plugin uses the TinyPNG API to compress and optimize images for better performance.
  • What data is sent and when: Image files are sent to the TinyPNG API for compression when the user requests optimization.
  • Service provider details: This service is provided by TinyPNG. You can find their terms of service and privacy policy below:
    • Terms of Service: https://tinypng.com/developers
    • Privacy Policy: https://tinypng.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. That’s it! you can now configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
1.What if I face issues with the plugin? Do you provide support for free products?
If you are facing any issues, please create a topic at plugin support section on wordpress org. Our team will respond back soon.
